description:
**Severity**: P3 (hygiene)

The current `bw` list contains many duplicate tickets generated by
multiple runs of the catseye static analyzer and other automated
tools. The duplicates describe the same single bug.

**Confirmed duplicate groups** (from code review 2026-06-18, §7):

| Bug | Open tickets | Recommended action |
|---|---|---|
| FeedCache duplicate getter | `bmx`, `e4r`, `8rp`, `4vk`, `ffc` (5) | Close 4 as dups of `bmx` |
| PRAGMA mmap contradiction | `hs8`, `u98`, `21n`, `470`, `h7l`, `x84`, `0ia`, `awi` (8) | Close 7 as dups of `hs8` |
| Stale max_heap in gc log | `r0a`, `oj4` (2) | Close one as dup |

The Memory leak EPIC and Architecture EPIC duplicates are
already closed (see history of `tlr`, `y94`, `v6m`).

**Approach**:
1. For each group, pick the canonical ticket
2. Close the rest with `bw close <id>` and a comment linking to
   the canonical ticket
3. Verify the canonical ticket is the most descriptive

**Why not just delete them?** `bw close` keeps history; `bw delete`
loses the audit trail. Closing as duplicates is the right move.

Found during code review 2026-06-18, see
`planning/code-review-2026-06-18.md` §7.
title: Consolidate duplicate tickets from automated scanners (catseye, etc.)
